panelDescription: Everything you can change, grouped by what it touches.
panelProjectHint: Open a project in the left sidebar to edit its name, status, colours and rate.
sectionColoursHint: Every colour in the interface, with suggested companions.
sectionProjectHint: Name, status, colours and rate of the project you have open.
sectionWorkspaceHint: Shape, spacing, typeface and reading comfort.
sectionRemindersHint: When and how a task announces itself.
sectionCalendarHint: How the grid behaves and what a full day means.
sectionTimerHint: Pomodoro lengths, countdowns and what lands in history.
sectionBehaviourHint: What the app does on its own.
sectionClientsHint: Who you bill, and which projects go to them.
sectionFormatHint: Interface language, and how dates and times are written.
sectionDataHint: Everything you have, in and out of a file.
carryForwardHint: Off leaves an undated task on the day it was made instead of moving it to today.
keyboardShortcutsHint: N adds a task, Space runs the timer, ? lists the rest. Off turns them all off.
tipsHint: Short notes that point at the control they explain. Close one with ×, or turn them all off here.
undoWindowHint: How long a delete stays reversible.
colourIntro: Pick any colour by hand. Each field can also suggest companions built from the rest of your palette — a complement for the colours that should stand apart, a neighbouring hue for the ones that should belong.
groupMainColoursHint: What tasks, projects and actions are painted with.
groupSurfacesHint: The canvas, the cards on it and the frames around them.
groupTextAlertsHint: Everything that has to stay readable on those surfaces.
tokenAccentDescription: Primary colour: buttons, progress rings, active states.
tokenProjectsDescription: Project circles, badges and calendar blocks.
tokenTasksDescription: Ordinary task circles and their calendar blocks.
tokenPanelsDescription: Cards, the sidebar and every raised surface.
paletteForgeHint: The DayForge original: neon lime on deep navy.
paletteEvergreenHint: Green against charcoal — the calm classic pairing.
paletteDeepOceanHint: Cyan and rose: cool, low-glare, easy at night.
paletteSunsetHint: Warm amber against plum — high energy.
paletteGrapeHint: Violet accent on a near-black canvas.
paletteSlateHint: Monochrome greys — nothing competes for attention.
palettePaperHint: Warm off-white with ink — daylight reading.
paletteMeadowHint: Fresh green on a bright, airy canvas.
projectColourAccentDescription: Buttons, the habit ring and active states in this project.
projectThemeIntro: Colours set here apply to {project} only — its panel, task circles, frames and habit ring. Everything else keeps the global theme.
projectTintHint: How far the colour bleeds into panels and borders.
projectCirclesDescription: Rows that hold other tasks, and their calendar blocks.
projectTaskCirclesDescription: Ordinary task circles inside this project.
projectBordersDescription: Frames and dividers inside the panel.
projectPanelsDescription: Cards and raised surfaces inside the panel.
projectNoClients: No clients yet. Add them under Settings, then Clients.
projectStatusHintActive: Today's list is rebuilt from this project every morning, as usual.
projectStatusHintPaused: Its tasks stop arriving on today: repeats no longer fire and unfinished ones stay on the day they were left. Rows already on today are kept, and nothing is deleted.
projectStatusHintArchived: Paused, and the project also drops out of the sidebar list — it stays visible only while it is the one you have open.
projectBoardHint: Adds a List / Board switch to this project. The board shows the day's tasks in To do, In progress and Done.
projectDeleteNote: Deleting the project also deletes every task in it and every day row they produced. Only a backup file can bring it back.
projectDeleteConfirm: Delete "{title}" with all of its tasks? This cannot be undone.
remindersLabel: Remind me before a task starts
remindersNoSupport: This browser has no notification support, so reminders stay off.
remindersPlannedHint: In the app, these show while DayForge is open. Turn on "Notify me when the app is closed" to get them as push notifications too.
remindersLateLabel: Ask to start the timer on a late block
remindersLateHint: When a scheduled block began 5 min ago with no timer running.
remindersEveningLabel: Evening nudge to log planned blocks
remindersEveningHint: After {time}, once a day, if finished blocks have no time logged.
remindersPushLabel: Notify me when the app is closed
remindersPushHint: Timer and planned-block reminders arrive as browser notifications. They are checked every few minutes, so they can come a little late. Works on this device only.
remindersBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser settings.
remindersRepeatHint: Off means one chime and the popup waits quietly.
remindersQuietHint: Nothing is queued during this window, not even held back.
timerIntro: One timer runs at a time. It keeps counting while the tab is closed, and settles up when you come back.
timerRemindersHint: In the app, these show while DayForge is open. Turn on "Notify me when the app is closed" in Reminders to get them as push notifications too. A closed tab cannot remind you.
timerLongRunLabel: Remind me after the timer has run
timerIdleLabel: Ask what to do after I was away for
timerAutoBreaksHint: Off means a finished focus phase waits for you.
timerAutoFocus: Start the next focus on its own
timerAutoFocusHint: A break rolls straight back into work.
timerChimeHint: Uses the reminder volume. Silent while the tab is closed.
timerRateHint: Projects and tasks bill at their own rate when they have one. This is the fallback for everything else. Zero keeps it out of the way.
calendarIntro: The grid always covers a full 00:00–24:00 day, so a task can never be scheduled somewhere it cannot be seen.
calendarZoomHint: Zoom for the day and week grids.
calendarFullDayHint: The scale the month view tints a day's workload against.
workspaceTextSizeHint: Scales every label in the app, layout included.
workspaceCornerHint: 0% is square, 100% is the designed shape.
workspaceGlowHint: How strongly the accent lights the canvas behind panels.
workspaceLargerTargetsHint: Roomier buttons, rows and circles — easier to hit on a phone.
workspaceHighContrastHint: Firmer borders and text, no translucent surfaces.
dataIntroSignedIn: This browser holds a full copy of everything, and so does your account — the two keep themselves in step on their own. A backup file is still the only copy that survives both.
dataIntroLocal: Everything lives in this browser's local storage — nothing is sent anywhere. A backup file is the only copy that survives clearing site data or moving to another machine.
dataImportNote: Importing replaces the current projects and tasks. The undo toast can put them back if it was the wrong file.
dataSnapshotsNote: Taken by itself just before your data was first merged with an account, so there is always a way back if the result was not what you expected. The three most recent are kept.
dataRestoreNote: Restoring works like importing a file: the undo toast can take it back.
dataStarterNote: Reopens the three onboarding questions, which otherwise only appear on a brand-new install.
dataClearNote: Reversible from the undo toast until it disappears — export first if you want a copy that lasts.
dataClearSignedIn: Your account itself stays. The deletion reaches every device signed in to it.
dataClearLocal: No account exists for this data, so this only clears projects and tasks stored in this browser.
dataDeleteAccountNote: Permanently deletes your account and every project, task, habit and time entry stored on the server, then erases this device's copy too. This cannot be undone.
backupNotJson: That file is not valid JSON.
backupNotDayforge: That JSON is not a DayForge backup.
backupImportedNewer: Imported {name}. This backup was made by a newer version of DayForge; some data may not be shown.
suggestHintAccentTuned: Same hue, lightness adjusted to read on your panels.
suggestHintAccentWarmer: One step around the wheel towards red.
suggestHintAccentCooler: One step towards blue — calmer over a long session.
suggestHintAccentVivid: More saturation: the accent speaks up.
suggestHintAccentBlended: Pulled towards your text colour so it sits inside the theme.
suggestHintMajorComplement: Opposite the accent — projects read apart from tasks.
suggestHintMajorTriad: A third of the wheel away — balanced and distinct.
suggestHintMajorAmber: The classic project orange, tinted by your accent.
suggestHintMajorSameFamily: A brighter accent, for a single-hue palette.
suggestHintMinorMatchAccent: Tasks share the accent — the most cohesive option.
suggestHintMinorAnalogous: A neighbouring hue: related, still separable.
suggestHintMinorAnalogousCool: The other neighbour, a shade calmer.
suggestHintMinorSoft: Low saturation, so projects keep the loud colour.
suggestHintMinorNeutral: No hue at all — the Minimal theme look.
suggestHintBgAccentTint: Barely tinted with your accent — surfaces feel related.
suggestHintBgNeutral: Pure greyscale: lets the accent do all the talking.
suggestHintBgImmersive: A stronger wash of the accent across the canvas.
suggestHintPanelLifted: One step off the background — the usual card look.
suggestHintPanelAccentTint: Cards pick up a hint of the accent.
suggestHintPanelFlat: Same as the background — panels read through borders only.
suggestHintLineAccentFrame: Borders tinted with the accent — frames join the theme.
suggestHintLineDefined: Stronger outlines for a more structured layout.
suggestHintTextClassic: Maximum readability against the default panels.
suggestHintTextAccentTint: A whisper of the accent in every line of text.
suggestHintMutedBalanced: Between your text and panel — reliably legible.
suggestHintMutedAccentTint: Captions carry a trace of the accent.
suggestHintDangerMatched: Red at the same saturation and lightness as your accent.
suggestHintDangerHotRed: For palettes that already lean magenta.
suggestModeDarkBright: Bright, saturated colours glow on a dark canvas and glare on a light one.
suggestModeLightDeep: Deep colours keep their detail against a light background.
suggestModeDarkNeutral: Near-neutral colours look deliberate in a dark, minimal workspace.
suggestModeDarkLighter: A little lighter than mid-tone — it separates best from a dark surface.
suggestModeLightDarker: A little darker than mid-tone — it separates best from a light surface.
contrastOk: Contrast {ratio}:1 — fine for large shapes, tight for small text.
contrastPoor: Contrast {ratio}:1 — hard to see on this surface.
pushNotSetUp: Push reminders are not set up on this build.
pushIosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, add DayForge to your Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen) and open it from there. Needs iOS 16.4 or later.
pushUnsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
pushIncomplete: The browser returned an incomplete subscription.
pushBlocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings, then try again.
pushNotReady: The app is not ready for background reminders yet. Reload the page and try again.
